note: Council of Ministers communiqué of 11 October 2025: the only civil-status line is a joint communication of the Interior and Budget ministers on a public purchase (300 million CFA francs or more, by the threshold cited) for the making and printing of civil-status forms (imprimés d'état civil); it names no civil registration system and does not say how a centre makes its record. The ANCE and CNAC decrees concern electronic certification and cybersecurity, outside the study's field.
